## Generation and export

- Built-in image generation edit. One generation with two image references.
- Requested dimensions: 1774 × 887 or greater at the same 2:1 ratio.
- Returned dimensions: **1774 × 887**. The master was copied without modification.
- Export: Sharp resize to 1280 × 640 with the Lanczos3 kernel.
- PNG export: compression level 9, palette disabled.
- No tracing, sharpening, blend effect or lossy recompression.
